name: Apatura Ravenscraig AI Energy Campus
notes: Proposed 550MW data centre campus plus 150MW BESS at former Ravenscraig steelworks, Motherwell (~160 acres, up to GBP 3.9bn); submitted for UK AI Growth Zone programme; EIA screening opinion request May 2025; still in planning stage as of Aug 2026 (no approval found).

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Apatura Drumshangie / Plains Data Centre
notes: Pre-planning 500MW proposal at Drumshangie moss / former coal mine near Greengairs/Airdrie with PAN 26/00069/PAN; source is advocacy/aggregator (APRS) rather than developer; treat as lead pending council confirmation.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Aurelius AI Data Centre (North Lanrigg / Newhouse)
notes: ILI consultation site describes AI-focused hyperscale data centre at North Lanrigg, Carlisle Road, Motherwell/Cleland (reported as Newhouse location by The National, Aug 2026); third-party profile cites North Lanarkshire PAN 25/00989/PAN and 400MW target.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Lanarkshire AI Growth Zone - South Lanridge / Chapelhall (DataVita / CoreWeave)
developer: HFD Renewables NL / DataVita; CoreWeave named in reporting
notes: UK Government AI Growth Zone in North Lanarkshire with c.500MW data centre capacity and GBP 8.2bn+ investment; planning portal records PAN 25/01328/PAN (South Lanridge Farm); DataVita/CoreWeave announced GBP 1.5bn AI infrastructure investment in 2026; still in planning.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: DataVita Fortis / Chapelhall expansion
notes: Planning Permission in Principle application 25/01159/PPP approved 9 Jan 2026 for Chapelhall/Fortis extension to 40MW; APRS records the approval; directories describe DataVita Fortis/DV1 at Chapelhall with proposed DV3 expansion.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Microsoft Project Natick Phase 2 / Northern Isles underwater datacentre
notes: 12-rack, 864-server underwater pod deployed June 2018 at EMEC Orkney and retrieved after about two years; Microsoft confirmed in 2024 that Project Natick is no longer active; 0.24MW widely reported for the pod but not in the primary Microsoft page; no new Orkney facility found (checked 2026-08-12).

notes: Hyperscale data centre proposal on green belt farmland southwest of Hamilton (Haspielaw), developer Apatura; EIA required; capacity not disclosed in planning documents; APRS aggregator source.

name: Coalburn 2 Data Centre and Green Energy Opportunity
notes: South Lanarkshire Council granted planning permission in principle May 2020 (P/19/0896) for c.400,000 sq ft two-level data centre with 12MW solar farm and 7.5MW gas turbine; earlier PAN documents describe a 75MW data centre; later Alcemi material notes a reduced-scale hydrogen development may overlap/mutually exclude the data-centre scheme, so current status is uncertain.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Asanti Hamilton Data Centre
notes: Operational regional colocation/disaster-recovery facility at Asanti House, 4 Lister Way, Hamilton International Technology Park, Blantyre; public directories list ~5,000 sq ft whitespace; Asanti acquired the site from Daisy Group in 2022.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Apatura Plean / Torwood AI Data Centre Campus
notes: Apatura submitted a PAN to Stirling and Falkirk councils for a 43.1 ha Plean/Torwood campus (300MW utility capacity) but changed location to Larbert (Glenbervie Business Park, Falkirk), where a full planning application was lodged 29 May 2026; the Stirling/Plean site did not proceed so is coded rejected for this division; no other Stirling facility found.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Southside Data Centre (Longformacus / Duns)
developer: Sunlaws Development Company Limited / Roxburghe Estate
notes: GBP 2bn, 225MW data centre proposal near Duns/Longformacus; PAN submitted to Scottish Borders Council; public consultation events June 2026; significant local opposition (Save the Lammermuirs); planning stage.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Apatura Coldstream Data Centre Campus
notes: Proposed 300MW data centre campus with BESS near Coldstream/Laundry Field in the Scottish Borders; public sources indicate early planning/screening rather than construction.

name: Apatura Freeport AI Energy Campus (West Calder)
notes: Proposed 250MW AI Energy Campus at Freeport Leisure Village, Westwood, West Calder plus 250MW BESS; APRS cites PAC 0625/PAC/25; Apatura consultation site live as of Aug 2026; no approval yet.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Linlithgow Campus data centre (former Oracle facility)
notes: Former Oracle/Sun Linlithgow data centre site; marketing brochure says Oracle previously operated the on-site data centre, a certificate of lawfulness covers data centre use, and existing supply is 6.8MW with 4MW available; The Register reported in 2021 that Oracle planned to close the facility, so current operating status is uncertain.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Prosperity Parc data centre campus (Holyhead)
notes: Outline planning permission secured from Anglesey County Council for the 220-acre former Anglesey Aluminium site in Holyhead, including over 220,000 sq m of data centre, industrial and office space; public summaries cite a 349MW BESS; data-centre IT load not separately stated so capacity_mw left null.

name: Carbon3.ai Amlwch Port AI data centre
notes: Proposal to convert the former Octel factory at Amlwch Port into an AI data centre was rejected by Anglesey County Council in April 2026; no MW capacity found in public reports.
